title: moveItem: the rows on screen -> where the finger presses and where it releases, or why the step fails
description: Shared vector for the moveItem action (schemas/actions.schema.json; ticket jui-collection-drag-to-reorder). Run by the three drivers against their own gesture planning, before any gesture is made.

Coordinates are the screen's (points on iOS, pixels on Android and the web), y downward. A rect is [x, y, width, height]. rows maps an address (<id>_item_<n>) to the rects found for it: one rect is a row; none (absent) is a row not drawn; two or more is an address that repeats (several sections).

press: the centre of the handle's rect when the step gives `handle` (the reorderHandle id; the case's handle is the rect of that element found inside the from row, null when none was found), else the centre of the from row.

release: x is the press's x (the finger moves straight up or down); y is the to row's top + 3/4 of its height when to > from, + 1/4 when to < from. Never a centre: the shared reorder rule passes a row when the dragged centre goes beyond its centre, and iOS 27's standard reordering counts a centre exactly as passed (shared/core/reorder_vectors.json knownDifferences).

A row is on screen when its whole rect is inside the viewport. Then the press and the release must each be at least edgeMargin from the viewport's top and bottom: nearer, a list scrolls by itself under a held finger (its own auto-scroll band) and the row lands further than `to`. Measured on iOS 27.2 (iPhone 17, a SwiftUI List with onMove, window 874 pt with the 34 pt home indicator): a release 129 pt above the window's bottom landed on `to`, one 55 pt above it moved the row two places further. The libraries' own bands are 48 (shared/core/reorder_vectors.json autoScroll).

fail names the first reason, in this order: same (from == to), section (section is not 0), ambiguous:<address>, missing:<address>, offscreen:<address> (from checked before to), no-handle (the case declares a handle and none was found in the from row), edge:<address> (the press's row, then the release's, too near the top or bottom).
timing: press the from point and hold pressSeconds, move to the release point slowly, hold holdSeconds, release.
